tvShow.name: The Polygamist
tvShow.overview: Social media darling, Joyce, is the picture of marital perfection — until her cheating husband's conquests ignite a scandalous emotional meltdown.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Beyond the picture-perfect funeral tears and her immaculate influencer wife persona, Joyce leaves behind a past of rage and a marriage built on secrets.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As Matipa seductively weaves her way into the Gomora empire, Joyce's flawless brand and family begin to crumble.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Joyce stages a glamorous anniversary party to save her public image, forcing her broken family to smile through the betrayal.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Jonasi returns home. Matipa tries to win him back while Joyce is torn between peace and self-preservation.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Matipa’s expectations for a generous settlement fail, so she seeks greener (and more powerful) pastures.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: News of a possible pregnancy unsettles Joyce and raises new suspicions about family secrets.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After the birth of the twins, Joyce has an emotional breakdown. The children grow tired of Jonasi’s violent games.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: To survive the scandal, Joyce makes a desperate suggestion — turning private heartbreak into a shared experiment for power (polygamy).

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Joyce puts on a happy face, but the new marriage structure sparks social backlash and isolates the family.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: A secret first love emerges, revealing decades of sacrifice and Jonasi’s long-hidden lies.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Jonasi seeks birthday adoration from three women but faces resentment and family loneliness.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The twins’ Christening explodes into chaos as long-buried family secrets detonate.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Essie pleads with Joyce. Overwhelmed by secrets, Joyce considers abandoning fame to confront Jonasi.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Jonasi pursues a new conquest with power and luxury. Xolani publicly confronts Lindani.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Lindani desperately seeks help from Mpume and Joyce. Jonasi deepens his betrayals.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: The family home descends into chaos. Lindani’s mother steps in. Medical results enrage Joyce.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Joyce plays the dutiful wife while Jonasi is hospitalized, but his health issues don’t curb his thirst for power.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Matipa and Joyce find uneasy solidarity after Jonasi’s abuse. Magesh helps Joyce choose freedom.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: After alienating everyone, Jonasi receives harrowing health news while completely alone.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Three-year time jump: The Gomoras are thriving, but Jonasi returns as a shadow of his former self.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: Jonasi’s health fails as he lives discarded and alone. The family struggles with love and hate for him.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Competition between the wives continues beyond the grave as Essie and Joyce clash over how to memorialize Jonasi.
